31.title: One of the last 1959 F600s in Wyoming. It runs. It just can't go anywhere.
31.body: Facts from Jacob, 2026-11-22: the truck starts and runs, badly, and it does not move; it sits in a bay at the shop. Frame 1: Jacob's hand on the door, VO at 0.0: "This is one of the last 1959 Ford F600s left in Wyoming. It runs. It just can't go anywhere." The first ten seconds are the start-up as it really is (the crank, the smoke, the idle), then the case in order: what stops it from moving, what else is wrong as it sits, what the lumber company left behind, the one thing that makes people say leave it alone. The answer held to the last ten seconds: the 7.3, the Super Duty frame, SEMA 2027 as the target. Face not before 20 s. 90 to 120 s. Caption line 1: "Send this to the guy who says you should never cut up an original." Title number: "one of the last". Shoot note (2026-11-22): the shop may be in frame, Jacob wants the association; say "I work there" once on camera, keep customers, plates and invoices out of the shot. Platform: TikTok and Shorts first.
